claims.claim: Rebellions plans to adopt NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation R200 neural processing units for rack-scale inference.

claims.supporting_quote: Rebellions plans to adopt NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation R200 neural processing units to NVIDIA’s open infrastructure platform for rack-scale inference.

claims.claim: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in its AI data center to support services under Korea’s AI for All project.

claims.supporting_quote: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in its AI data center to support its vision for full-stack sovereign AI spanning infrastructure, proprietary models and public-facing services, including those under Korea’s “AI for All” project.

claims.claim: Rebellions' R200 is described as optimized for inference including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.

claims.supporting_quote: Rebellions is developing its next-generation R200 NPU, optimized for low-latency and energy-efficient inference using frontier models, including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.
